name: The Cypher Club
bio:
A home for Hip-Hop & street culture. 🖤
Cyphers • Battles • Events • Community
Bringing the culture to the block.
📍Kolkata, India
description: The Cypher Club is a home for Hip-Hop and street culture. From breakers, wackers, poppers, lockers and krumpers to DJs, artists and music lovers - we bring people together through cyphers, battles, showcases, block parties and unforgettable experiences. No boundaries, no fake hype - just raw talent, music, movement and culture. Built for the community, by the community.
